remote-summariser.description: A role bound to a backend outside the lab whose provider's terms are on record (no retention, no training): its TLP ceiling is raised from clear to green. A module requiring it still needs grants.cloud_models.

provider_terms.ref: the provider's data-processing terms, version 2026-09, read by the lab operator

local-summariser.description: A local primary that falls back to the raised role: its prompts can leave the lab, so it declares the raised ceiling too.
